justified_source_applications.application: Firm special retirements qualify for London display selection.
justified_source_applications.basis: Rules p37 physicalLF2651–2660 says otherwise like any retirement; p12 physicalLF1003–1014 controls selection and exhausted display.
justified_source_applications.assessment: Justified source application, not a guess.

justified_source_applications.application: Company-controlled Deploy has zero tower trophies and surviving-officers+1 minimum loot.
justified_source_applications.basis: Rules p22 physicalLF1630–1647 explicitly permits such targets with effect and zero defense; p23 physicalLF1675–1696 supplies loot minimum/trophies.

justified_source_applications.application: Successful Governor General cash is a family bonus from bank.
justified_source_applications.basis: Rules p6 physicalLF662–668 explains highlighted personal extra-income boxes; p26 physicalLF1870–1872 is the corresponding highlighted payment.

justified_source_applications.application: Firm scoring rounds each player’s aggregate once and precedes special retirement/ordinary scoring.
justified_source_applications.basis: Rules p37 physicalLF2665–2674; debtor penalty fixed at -1 by p41 physicalLF2839–2843.

justified_source_applications.application: Last dominated-region loss removes surviving capital flag irrespective of event.
justified_source_applications.basis: Rules p7 physicalLF713–714 says if ever reduced to only capital; it applies to Rebellion and Company conquest as well as ordinary Invasion.

justified_source_applications.application: Only the newly exhausted combined defense strength >= attack controls Crisis defense.
justified_source_applications.basis: Explicit human authority in both read and hashed scope files; not inferred from printed equal wording. Local-alliance indivisibility remains Rules p22 physicalLF1622–1626.
justified_source_applications.assessment: Authorized interpretation; faithfully attributed. No publisher email verification dependency or citation-based cap.
